frozen_at: 2026-09-30, after stage C (results/mapping.json), before any formal stream was generated

templates.transform: TEMPLATE_TRANSLATION only (window start shifted; duration, ramp and amplitude unchanged)

working_domain.event_times: W window at +0.10 s each cycle; LATER window at +0.10+d_L if y=1

D_main.seed_rule: stream s uses random.Random(20260930 + s) for y and d_L; seeds never used in development
D_main.reference: z_ref(n+1) = (1-alpha0) z_ref(n) + alpha0 y(n), same y, z_ref(0)=z0

criteria.A1_mapping: max over streams and cycles |z_dev - z_ref| <= 0.05
criteria.A2_adaptation: per phase, cross-stream mean of window-mean actual prediction within +-0.05 of p (task tolerance); 95% CI half width <= 0.03 else INCONCLUSIVE (statistical precision)
criteria.A3_recovery: experiences after each reversal until actual prediction first crosses 0.5 to the new side; cross-stream median <= 15 at both reversals (analytic mean-dynamics value 6.6)
criteria.A4_causal: device window Brier < no_write window Brier in phases 2 and 3 (descriptive vs fixed-0.5 and oracle; no 'better by 10%' gate)
criteria.A5_integrity: one Rig per stream (no rebuild); exactly one W entry per cycle; LATER entries == y; O_end < 1e-3 every cycle; energy ledger reported
criteria.pass: A1 and A2 and A3 and A4 and A5

D_main.stop_rule: no reruns to reach success; failures reported as-is

E_two_history.condition: run automatically iff D passes, stage C selectivity passed (max cross write 0.0) and budget remains
E_two_history.per_phase: 60 experiences per history, order = random permutation of 60+60 (balanced, pre-generated per stream)
E_two_history.baseline_shared: single-carrier device, both W templates drive the same timer input, streams 0-3

criteria.B1_cross_write: max over cycles |delta z of the non-presented carrier| <= 1e-6 (natural leak of Memristor = 0)
criteria.B2_differentiation: per phase and history, cross-stream mean of window-mean actual prediction (last 30 own experiences) within +-0.05 of its p; CI half width <= 0.03 else INCONCLUSIVE
criteria.B3_recovery: per history, own-experience count to cross 0.5 after each exchange; median <= 15
